Step: Sign in at /admin with your test account
Expected result: You land on the Dashboard; the sidebar shows your role name

Step: Enter a wrong password
Expected result: You see "Invalid email or password" and are not signed in

Step: Click each item in the sidebar
Expected result: The current page is highlighted in red and each screen opens

Step: Open Site Settings / Team / Activity log
Expected result: All three open

Step: Try to open /admin/users /admin/settings /admin/activity
Expected result: You are sent back to the Dashboard with a notice

Step: Look at the sidebar
Expected result: You see only Dashboard / Guide / News / Projects / Media (no site pages / FAQ / Careers / Submissions / RSS)

Step: Open any page editor
Expected result: Fields are greyed out and there is no Save bar; a view-only notice is shown

Step: Look for a Delete button on a news post
Expected result: There is no Delete button (only Administrators delete)

Step: Create a new user with each role on the Team screen
Expected result: The account is created; the role legend explains each role

Step: Deactivate a user who is signed in elsewhere
Expected result: Their next click returns them to the sign-in page

Step: Open Site pages > Home page on a wide screen
Expected result: An "On this page" list appears on the right and highlights as you scroll

Step: Click a section heading
Expected result: The section folds; click again to open it

Step: Use Collapse all then Expand all
Expected result: All sections fold and unfold

Step: Scroll to the bottom of Home and look at the bottom bar
Expected result: "Save changes" is always visible

Step: Edit a field then click a sidebar link
Expected result: You are asked to confirm leaving without saving

Step: On Home change the hero heading and press Preview unsaved
Expected result: A new tab shows the change with an "UNSAVED" banner; the editor says nothing was saved

Step: Reload the Home page editor
Expected result: Your typed change is NOT there (it was never saved)

Step: Press Preview draft (next to Save)
Expected result: The tab shows the last saved version with a "SAVED" banner

Step: Open a news draft and press Preview unsaved
Expected result: The article shows as typed with the UNSAVED banner

Step: Change the SEO title on Home; set Status = Published; Save
Expected result: The message says it is live; reload the editor and the value is still there

Step: Open Version history under the editor
Expected result: A new version appears with your name

Step: Restore the previous version
Expected result: The earlier content returns; a new version is recorded

Step: Set Status = Draft and Save
Expected result: The message says the public page is unchanged

Step: Create a post and save it as Draft; then set In review
Expected result: It is saved; you cannot choose Published

Step: Open a Published post
Expected result: You cannot change it (the save is refused with a message)

Step: Open the In review post and set it Published
Expected result: It appears on the public News page

Step: Use Duplicate on a post
Expected result: A copy is created as Draft

Step: Use Unpublish on a published post
Expected result: It disappears from the public site

Step: Upload an image
Expected result: It appears in the library

Step: Set Alt text on the image
Expected result: The text shows under the thumbnail

Step: Try to upload a .exe or a file over 25 MB
Expected result: A clear error appears before anything uploads

Step: Remove an image from the library
Expected result: It is removed from the list

Step: Submit the Contact form on the public site
Expected result: It appears in Submissions within a minute

Step: Submit the Careers open application with a PDF CV
Expected result: The submission shows a CV tag; the detail page downloads the PDF

Step: Open a submission and read the Salesforce status
Expected result: It says pending (or synced/failed once Salesforce is connected)

Step: Open a submission
Expected result: You can read it and download the CV but there is no Retry button

Step: Press Fetch feeds now
Expected result: New items appear in the review queue

Step: Approve one item
Expected result: A DRAFT news post is created (not published)

Step: On the FAQ list drag a row onto another row in the same category
Expected result: The new order is saved and shows after refresh; the public FAQ page follows it

Step: Use the up/down buttons on the Projects list
Expected result: The project moves within its sector

Step: Open Guide in the sidebar
Expected result: It explains your role and the features above

Step: Check the sign-in page and a few screens
Expected result: It looks like the KC MENA site (black/white/grey with the red accent and the logo)

Step: Open the CMS on a phone or narrow window
Expected result: Content stays readable and nothing overlaps
